metadata.dcterms:title: NON–ABELIAN REIDEMEISTER TORSION FOR TWIST KNOTS
metadata.dcterms:creator: JÉR ÔME DUBOIS, VU HUYNH
YAMAGUCHI, YOSHIKAZU
metadata.dcterms:abstract: This paper gives an explicit formula for the SL 2(C)−non–abelian Reidemeister torsion as deﬁned in [Dub06] in the case of twist knots. For hyperbolic twist knots, we also prove that the non–abelian Reidemeister torsion at the holonomy representation can be expressed as a rational function evaluated at the cusp shape of the knot.
